aggregate_weighting: Equal DR and equal motion. Bootstrap 512 motion indices jointly across all 8 DRs, 2000 repeats.
limitations: One training seed; bootstrap intervals reflect evaluated motion variation, not training-seed variation.
Reference uses continuous random DR; each B trains on one fixed complete DR, so training distributions differ.
Equal updates, not equal samples: A has four times the transitions of one B; the eight Bs together have twice A's transitions.
Body/joint primary errors use common survival steps. Root/other errors and returns use each policy's own observed episode; read with failure and coverage.
Zero limb payload still has other static DR; these eight profiles are not a pure payload-only sweep.

comparison.bootstrap_unit: motion; one fixed-start episode per motion
comparison.interpretation: Specialization relative to the existing continuous-DR universal A; not an equal-training-distribution or equal-total-samples ablation

residual_saturation_fraction.definition: Per-motion mean fraction of joint means with abs(residual) >= 0.95 * 0.25; then equal-motion average
